Dogecoin Labs Officially Launches to Expand DOGE into Payments and DeFi Dogecoin Labs has officially launched with support from the Dogecoin Foundation. Jordan Jefferson, founder of DogeOS, will serve as CEO. The new entity brings together the MyDoge wallet, DogeOS app platform and Such App payment product to expand DOGE use in payments, commerce, DeFi and gaming. DogeOS launched its EVM-compatible public testnet on Sept. 30, while Such App offers merchant invoicing and offline QR payments. Dogecoin Labs will operate independently, while the Foundation continues to oversee ecosystem governance and open-source development. — link

SkyAI Liquidates All SOL Holdings and Proceeds with $201M Buyback; Major Shareholder Calls for Board Accountability and Better Terms SkyAI’s major shareholder, Bastion Trading, criticized the company for proceeding with its $201 million cash tender offer despite earlier requests for improved terms and greater transparency. Bastion called on the Chairman and directors individually to explain their oversight of these transactions. Bastion also continued to urge SkyAI to raise the tender price from $3.00 to at least $3.50, allow 100% tender of pre-funded warrants instead of 95%, and exclude insider-related strategic advisor warrants to ensure fairer treatment of investors. SkyAI previously stated that the buyback aims to optimize its capital structure and provide liquidity to shareholders. The company has not separately responded to the latest concerns over board accountability and potential conflicts of interest. — link

Grayscale Launches In-Kind Investing Service Covering 10 Digital Assets, Including BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, and DOGE Grayscale has announced In-kind Investing, allowing eligible investors to exchange digital assets directly for shares in its products without first converting their crypto into cash. The service currently covers 10 products involving BTC, ETH, SOL, AVAX, LINK, DOGE, HYPE, SUI, XRP, and ZEC. Grayscale said the mechanism can reduce self-custody burdens and potential transaction costs while bringing digital assets into traditional portfolio management. — link

Critical PHP Vulnerabilities Spark Global Security Alert; SlowMist Warns Crypto Exchanges, DeFi Platforms and Wallet Providers SlowMist said its MistEye threat intelligence system conducted a global scan of PHP-related assets across the crypto industry following the disclosure of two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, both rated 9.2 under CVSS v4.0. The flaws could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on affected servers under certain conditions. PHP released security patches on October 21, covering versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. SlowMist urged crypto exchanges, DeFi platforms, and wallet providers to assess their exposure and apply the updates promptly. — link
